gate_reasoning: Stage 4 scores 53 Low out of 89 total claims (59.6% Low), which falls below the implied 70% FAIL threshold applied to Stage 3 but significantly above the clean-pass threshold. The stage is substantively better evidenced than Stage 3 in two respects: (1) PP4.5 (water treatment) is a genuine novel finding anchored by three independent primary_academic sources (UTM Perak study 37 mills/1,427 data points, USM Perak BFW study, AIP Conference Proceedings 2023) that collectively establish this as a real operational gap across Malaysian palm oil mills — not speculation; and (2) the regulatory framework claims (PP4.3) are well-sourced at primary_gov and primary_ministry level for Indonesia and Malaysia. However, four critical structural weaknesses require flagging before this stage can be cited as investable research: FIRST, the entire lifecycle cost breakdown (fuel 60-70%, maintenance 10-15%, etc.) rests on a single vendor blog (coalbiomassboiler.com) and propagates through every downstream cost claim across all five pain points — this is the highest-priority deep-research target. SECOND, the $1M+ per day downtime cost in PP4.2 originates from the same company that sells the water treatment solution (Lautan Air Indonesia / beta.co.id), creating a vendor-interest conflict in the only source for the headline severity claim. THIRD, the Indonesia sugar mill count (69 mills) is sourced from a Chinese boiler manufacturer's case study page (zozenboiler.com) — a market-sizing anchor that requires BPS census validation. FOURTH, the PP4.4 operator shortage evidence is structurally inferential (World Bank construction certification rate, MPOB palm oil labor shortage) but lacks a boiler-operator-specific census or enumeration. The stage can be shipped for reader consumption with these four flags prominently disclosed; the claims that are High or Medium confidence (including the regulatory framework, EFB chemistry, water quality study findings, and IEA energy data) are genuinely useful and well-evidenced. Deep research targeting the five weak claims above should be triggered before the Stage 4 findings are used to size commercial opportunity or estimate total addressable market.
